jobs.title: Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research Technician
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Announcement: Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research Technician

Company: California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI2)

Location: San Diego, CA

Job Type: Full-time

Pay Rate: $25.00 – $30.00 / hour (commensurate with experience)

Start Date: Immediate start available / Available to start as soon as possible

Work authorization requirements:

Applicants with CPT/OPT are welcome, and H-1B visa support is available for eligible non-

U.S. candidates.

Green card (permanent residency) sponsorship may be o ered after three years of

employment if performance is outstanding.

About Us

California Medical Innovations Institute (CalMI) is a non-profit medical research

organization dedicated to translational research and medical device innovation across

multiple biological systems, including cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, lymphatic, and

endocrine systems. We are seeking a motivated Medical Assistant / Veterinary Research

Technician to join our research team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Surgical & Interventional Procedure Support

 Assist medical doctors, veterinarians, and principal investigators during acute and

chronic surgical, interventional, and catheterization procedures on large and small

animal models, including pigs, dogs, rabbits, rats, and mice.

 Prepare operating rooms, organize surgical trays, and ensure sterile fields and

appropriate instrumentation for cardiovascular, GI, lymphatic, and endocrine

studies.

 Assist in animal positioning, physiological monitoring (ECG, blood pressure, airway

dynamics), and anesthesia logging under veterinary oversight.

2. Pre- and Post-Operative Care Manage pre-procedure preparation, including fasting schedules, pre-medication

administration, and surgical site clipping/cleansing.

 Monitor animals during post-operative recovery, including vital sign tracking, pain

assessment, and administration of prescribed medications/treatments.

 Maintain clear and accurate surgical logs, recovery records, and medical progress

notes.

3. Daily Animal Care & Husbandry

 Perform daily animal husbandry, feeding, health checks, and behavioral observation

for research models in compliance with facility standards.

 Collect blood, tissue, and biological fluid samples following study protocols and

Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) principles.

 Support animal acclimation, handling, and habituation to minimize stress and

ensure study compliance.

4. Technical Support & Laboratory Maintenance

 Maintain, clean, sterilize, and inventory surgical tools, anesthesia machines,

monitoring equipment, and lab consumables.

 Ensure procedure rooms and holding facilities are sanitized and prepared in

accordance with institutional guidelines.

 Assist with specimen processing, tissue harvesting, and preliminary lab

testing/storage.

5. Compliance & Teamwork

 Strictly adhere to IACUC protocols, Institutional Safety Guidelines, USDA

regulations, and GLP standards.

 Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams including scientists, surgeons,

veterinarians, and laboratory personnel.

 Demonstrate flexibility in adopting new experimental procedures, handling various

species, and fulfilling additional operational duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements

 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Animal Science, Health Sciences, or a

related field. Availability & Schedule: Available for an immediate start. Weekend and holiday

work is required.

 Experience: Open to recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. Prior

hands-on lab or animal care experience is a plus, but comprehensive training will be

provided.

 Key Traits: Adaptable, eager to learn new technical skills, strong work ethic, and

attention to detail.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

 Exposure to animal allergens and repetitive motion.

 Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift up to 50 lbs individually, and team-lift up to 250 lbs.

 Required immunizations/screenings based on species exposure (e.g., Tetanus,

Rabies, TB, MMR, Hepatitis B).

Benefits & Growth

 Comprehensive Training: Extensive hands-on professional training provided.

 Benefits & Perks:

o Competitive compensation

o Medical, dental, and vision insurance

o Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) insurance

o 401(k) retirement plan

o Paid time o (PTO) and paid holidays

 Visa & Permanent Residency Support:

o H-1B visa sponsorship available for qualified non-U.S. candidates.

o Green Card (permanent residency) sponsorship available after 3 years of

employment, contingent upon outstanding work performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates please email your resume/CV and a brief cover letter to

MWang@CalMI2.org. Please indicate your Work Authorization type and the earliest available start date in your application.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Laboratory Assistant -Clinical Laboratory 1
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

**Laboratory Assistant -Clinical Laboratory 1**

**Talented Medical Solutions**

**Contract**

**In-Office | Willits, CA, United States**

**26 weeks, 40 hrs,** **Variable Shift, 0830 - 1700; 1030 - 1900; 1400 - 2230. Must have CPT 1, 1 year of experience. Rotating weekends. No Call. Detail-oriented, organized, fast learner, and able to effectively prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.**

Nestled in the Gateway to the Redwoods, Howard Memorial takes pride in its legacy of providing exceptional, high-quality care since 1928. We are comprised of a state-of-the-art 74,000 square foot facility, with four surgery suites, an on-site farm-to-fork restaurant, and 25 beautiful private rooms designed with healing and comfort in mind. We provide a wide range of primary and specialty care services to best serve our community. Willits is home to excellent trails and nature areas for hikers, campers, and bicyclists. Whether it is the climate, moderate cost of living, or just the small-town atmosphere, it is a place where everyone receives a warm welcome and is treated like family.

**Job Summary:**

Collects blood specimens, as well as receives, handles, and processes specimens for Laboratory testing.

Receives, sorts, and accession specimens, assigning to appropriate pre-analytic and analytic workflow.

Completes computerized tasks related to patient registration and/or test order entry, specimen collection, receiving, and processing.

Performs basic post-analytic tasks, including distributing reports, storing and/or retrieving specimens.

Completes quality-related tasks such as documentation of work, maintaining a clean, stocked, and safe work area, and monitoring pending work, as well as escalating priority work.

Operates and/or uses basic pre-analytic lab equipment. Adheres to all local/state/federal regulations, codes, policies and procedures to ensure privacy and safety while delivering optimal patient care.

**Job Requirements:**

Education and Work Experience: High School Education/GED or equivalent: Required in CA; Preferred in OR and HI Associate's/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred

Experience in Phlebotomy in acute care environment: Preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Certified Phlebotomy Technician I (CPTI) license: Required in CA; Preferred in OR and HI

Facility Specific License/Certifications: Phlebotomy Tech (CPT) or Certified Phlebotomy Technician II (CPTII): Required

Basic Life Support (BLS) certification from approved vendor per AH policy: Required

**Essential Functions:**

Collects blood specimens for a variety of Laboratory tests using age-appropriate techniques; handles/transports Lab specimens and provides post-phlebotomy care to patients.

Receives specimens for testing; assesses specimens upon receipt according to established criteria to determine acceptability and takes action according to protocol, including escalating to licensed or certified personnel for direction.

Handles and processes a variety of specimen types to prepare them for analysis; adheres to protocols to maintain specimen integrity at all times.

Completes computerized tasks as appropriate for affiliate to ensure complete patient registration and/or test order entry into the lab information system, as well as generation of collection lists and/or labels.

Prepares and/or packages specimens for transport to another facility or outside reference laboratory and may complete computer steps necessary for processing referred specimens.

Maintains an adequate inventory of supplies in work area and/or on phlebotomy cart.

Maintains required records by completing basic documentation of pre-analytic and post-analytic work, as well as quality-related tasks.

Participates in managing the laboratory workflow by performing duties such as monitoring pending work, escalating priority work, locating specimens, and coordinating specimen recollections.

Verbally communicates released/reported results.

Routes, distributes, and retransmits released/reported results.

Stores and retrieves specimens.

Receives incoming calls for the laboratory and assists the caller as appropriate or transfers these calls to the appropriate laboratory section or person.

Communicates with customer to clarify ambiguous, unclear, or duplicate test orders. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

**Organizational Requirements:**

Our facility is committed to the safety and well-being of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.

**""Total Bed Count: 21\_ #Bed Types and How Divided:** ***N/A*** **Staffing Ratios: Days: 07:30 – 16:00, 14:00 – 22:30, 07:00 – 15:30 (micro), 12:00 – 20:30 (micro) Nights: 22:00 – 08:0 Weekends: The same as above Schedule Requirements: Call Required: No Weekend Coverage: Every other Weekend Scheduling Type: Lab Management Team Documentation System: Cerner Pathnet Communication: Outlook, Huddles, Department Meetings""**

jobs.title: Research Associate II, Cell Culture
jobs.description:
**Job description:**

**Overview:**

EnquBio, a dynamic technology-driven discovery and service company, is actively searching for a motivated and detail-oriented Research Associate, Cell Culture to join our research team. This is an excellent opportunity for a Research Associate with strong hands-on mammalian cell culture experience who enjoys taking ownership of cell health, quality and consistency while supporting innovative research.

The Research Associate will be responsible for the culture, maintenance, expansion, isolation, cryopreservation and banking of mammalian cells using rigorous aseptic technique. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with scientists and research staff to ensure reliable, high-quality cells are available to support experimental studies.

**Responsibilities:**

* Maintain mammalian cell cultures, including thawing, seeding, passaging, expansion, harvesting, cell counting, and cryopreservation.
* Support the isolation and culture of primary mammalian cells from biological samples.
* Monitor cell morphology, viability, confluency, growth characteristics, and overall culture health.
* Maintain cell banks and accurate inventories, including passage history, cryopreservation records, and storage locations.
* Apply rigorous aseptic technique and contamination-control practices throughout all cell culture activities.
* Perform or coordinate routine mycoplasma testing and promptly address potential contamination concerns.
* Prepare cells, media, reagents, and related materials to support research studies and cell-based assays.
* Maintain accurate and timely experimental records and follow established protocols and SOPs.
* Assist with troubleshooting, protocol optimization, and continuous improvement of cell culture workflows.
* Maintain an organized, clean, and well-stocked cell culture laboratory.
* Collaborate closely with scientists and other team members to coordinate cell culture activities with experimental needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2-4 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience, preferably in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or biomedical research environment.
* Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique including thawing, passaging, counting, expansion, harvesting, and cryopreservation.
* Understanding of cell culture contamination prevention and good laboratory practices.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate laboratory records.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple cell culture workflows simultaneously.
* Ability to perform routine activities independently and troubleshoot problems with guidance as needed.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative research team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cell banking and cryogenic sample inventory management.
* Familiarity with mycoplasma testing and cell-line authentication.
* Experience with automated cell counting and viability assessment.
* Experience working under established SOPs or quality-focused research environment.
* Experience contributing to cell culture protocol optimization or troubleshooting.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
